tests.name: P1 · Cart beside walkers · SE
tests.notes: A horse cart and three walkers share parallel lanes. Check the seated driver, horse body, and walkers beside the wheels. Frozen experiment on a 3-unit-wide path. The other P1 tests show this exact arrangement from different cameras. Each animal has its handler or cart team; colors and numbers identify independently reorderable parts.

tests.name: P2 · Cart passing a led donkey · NE
tests.notes: A horse cart passes an oncoming donkey and its handler in separate lanes. Check the handler, lead and horse silhouettes. Frozen experiment on a 3-unit-wide path. The other P2 tests show this exact arrangement from different cameras. Each animal has its handler or cart team; colors and numbers identify independently reorderable parts.

tests.name: P3 · Two carts passing · NW
tests.notes: A horse team and a donkey team pass in opposite lanes. Each retains its driver, shafts and draft animal. Frozen experiment on a 3.4-unit-wide path. The other P3 tests show this exact arrangement from different cameras. Each animal has its handler or cart team; colors and numbers identify independently reorderable parts.

tests.name: P3 · Two carts passing · SE
tests.notes: A horse team and a donkey team pass in opposite lanes. Each retains its driver, shafts and draft animal. Frozen experiment on a 3.4-unit-wide path. tests.name: P4 · Cart overtaking a led horse · SW
tests.notes: A donkey cart overtakes a led pack horse using the adjacent lane. Both complete teams face along the path. Frozen experiment on a 3-unit-wide path. The other P4 tests show this exact arrangement from different cameras. Each animal has its handler or cart team; colors and numbers identify independently reorderable parts.

tests.name: P8 · Led donkey yielding at a junction · SE
tests.notes: A handler and donkey wait on a side path while a horse cart passes along the main path. The handler stops at the near verge, clear of the cart lane. Frozen experiment on a 3-unit-wide path. The other P8 tests show this exact arrangement from different cameras. Each animal has its handler or cart team; colors and numbers identify independently reorderable parts.
